notes.title: Definitive Update!
notes.notes:
After previously claiming this update would not arrive, like so many of my other games Fragile Peace now gets the 'Definitive' treatment as well. While the game has received many updates over the years elsewhere, it never got one on Steam before as it was only released here earlier this year.
This can be regarded as the final update to the game, with which it is now completed.
Patches may still be added if need arises.

Features:


Music toggle button
New dialogue for Leader interfaces
Updated Difficulty levels; added new 'Absurd' Difficulty

notes.title: Definitive Update incoming - after all!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482988/a95347b36c09ea1e5b62d751cd9d4adb31376752.png"]

While Fragile Peace has been updated in itch.io and Gamejolt platforms since 2023, its release in Steam included a Steam-exclusive update which I the developer claimed to have been its last.

Well, I take that back.

Fragile Peace will get a Definitive Update later in June!

Some cool stuff incoming. Accompanied by a sale!
